design_time: after published R1; do not claim all rules were pre-R1 registered

rules.question: 正确声音监督添加了什么？
rules.allows: stimulus-related utility where direct paired evidence supports it
rules.forbids: correct-wrong alone as improvement over Stage1; weak evidence as zero information

rules.question: 时间组织改变了何种读出？
rules.allows: separate readout reuse from representation availability
rules.forbids: large refit recovery alone as timing superiority; gate as physiological latency

rules.question: 时间δ超出普通校准了吗？
rules.allows: temporal adaptation claim only at supported direct-comparison level
rules.forbids: AUC alone to beat monotone calibration; one significant arm versus another nonsignificant as interaction

rules.question: 个人更新最终比固定E0好吗？
rules.forbids: GC positive implies net benefit; subtract independent CIs

rules.question: 儿童跨刺激判别读出能否复用？
rules.allows: standard/deviant readout transfer under registered stimulus/history conditions
rules.forbids: abstract deviance or speech semantics from label role alone; AUC sign flipping

rules.question: 共享表示提供何种年龄信息？
rules.allows: development-related EEG information attributable to actual stage
rules.forbids: Stage1 age success as proof of Stage2 CS benefit or clinical diagnosis

rules.question: 共同应用下外部方法怎样？
rules.forbids: literature 99.93% versus our44-person accuracy; frozen EEG probe as full MindMix

rules.question: 是否支持拟定方法贡献？
rules.allows: supported contribution, unresolved claim or insufficient contribution
rules.forbids: new negative-result story; automatic R4 or unlimited rescue
